findings.criterion: Compare against a random library of equal size to the learned library at matched generation/seed/world
findings.mechanism: run_compounding.py:run_arm and run_curriculum.py:run_arm compute real=harvest(solutions) separately inside each arm. random_library(other,real) matches sizes of the random arm's own historically solved concepts, not the library arm's concepts. Different learning trajectories cause different concept counts and size distributions. test_random_library_matches_exact_sizes only tests the generator for one provided list, not equality across experimental arms.
findings.reproduction: Read pinned compounding_results.json and curriculum_results.json. For each seed and generation, compare runs[world][library][seed][g][library_size] with runs[world][random_library][seed][g][library_size], and similarly curriculum runs[library][seed] vs runs[random_library][seed]. Inspect independent per-arm harvest in both run_arm implementations.

limitations: Existing full experiment results were not independently re-executed in their entirety; the full rerun was stopped on a confirmed design failure
Measured CPU is sensitive to shared host load and not independently reproduced
Exhaustive numerical comparison uses the NumPy evaluator on all 65536 8-bit pairs; separate Python integer evaluator samples 1024 pairs, so separate-evaluator exhaustiveness is not established
Hash pinning detects accidental content changes, not collusion or external compromise
Failing the random-library comparison does not itself falsify reported raw solve rates or all possible library usefulness
proof_scope: Independent audit of pinned source, manifest and scoreboard; 19 DAG, 20 pull and 9 NC-079 tests; independent sealed/train cross-check for all three worlds and seeds 11/19/29; recomputation of scoreboard final verdicts; negative control comparison of random-arm concept counts against real-library counts for all stored generation rows. Full three-seed experiments were initiated but cancelled after a reproducible experimental-design violation was established. No full result reproduction, CPU reproducibility or unrestricted theoretical claim is asserted.
required_rework: Precompute real-library concept lists at each world/seed/generation and freeze their count and exact expression-size multiset as reference before constructing the random arm; do not permit the control arm to choose its own target sizes
Add an experiment-level regression test asserting identical per-generation library_size AND exact size multiset for the real-versus-random matched arms across three seeds
Republish all multi-seed results and CPU-budget verdicts with equal-size random controls, then request independent review
Document whether the separate evaluator must also run exhaustively for all 65536 input pairs to meet task acceptance
supported_findings: Candidate frozen source/evidence/scoreboard hashes are consistent
Deterministic sealed exams match across arm-independent draws and train-vs-sealed split is disjoint for checked seeds/worlds
Unit random_library helper returns exactly the input shape sizes when provided a fixed list
Stored scoreboard final verdicts mechanically reproduce; all world analyses report NO_COMPOUNDING, not a positive compounding claim
